messages:
Aisha: Morning team — quick sync on what to cut/ship for the Q2 observability roll. Goal: launch something useful for dashboards, trace linking, cost breakdown, and error analytics without blowing the infra budget.

Jon: Quick question — can we drop full trace sampling for MVP and just do request-id trace links? Saves a lot.

Priya: Yes — request-id linking + a tiny sampled set of full traces for debugging spikes. Propose 1% sampling by default, configurable. We'll need a trace-hook header (X-Req-ID) from clients.

Samira: From SRE POV, error grouping and a basic stack snippet are higher leverage than full traces initially. Those are cheap and reduce noise.

Aisha: Customers: Startup A asked for per-customer cost breakdown in-console; Enterprise B asked for retention/audit controls. We can't fully satisfy both at once. Thoughts on minimum surface?

Jon: Minimum for cost: per-route + per-model token spend over a 30d window, and an exportable CSV. Per-customer attribution needs an attribution key — P0 only for Dedicated/Private. Hosted can show per-account if they send an attribution header.

Priya: Proposed launch criteria (draft):
1) Per-route cost widget (30d + realtime-ish last 24h)
2) Error grouping with stack snippet and counts (able to group by top500 error messages)
3) Trace link: ability to jump from a trace id/request id into a sampled flamegraph/trace view
4) Canary rollout plan + monitoring playbook
5) Instrumentation + acceptance tests in perf lab

Samira: Add SLOs for acceptance: cost aggregation accuracy within 1% over synthetic workload, and instrumentation latency overhead <50ms p95. Also need an alerting hook for error-rate spikes (can be basic webhook in MVP).

Aisha: Good. On scope cuts: no advanced query builder for launch, no multi-tenant per-customer billing UI for hosted (Dedicated/Private only), no fancy anomaly detection — defer to Optimize. Keep export/template capabilities minimal.

Jon: I'll own the UI slices for cost and trace-link pages. Need mock APIs from Priya by Tuesday so UX can bake mocks into a working dashboard. :thumbsup:

Priya: Will deliver minimal endpoints: `/v1/observability/costs?range=30d&group_by=route` and `/v1/observability/trace-link?req_id=...`. Instrumentation note: require `X-Req-ID: <uuid>` header from clients. Also adding retention toggle in the private console API.

Priya: Code snippet for header we expect:
```
X-Req-ID: ${request_id}
```

Samira: For rollout safety — include an SRE runbook step to synthetic-hit top 10 routes and compare aggregated cost numbers before/after. Acceptance test should run nightly during canary.

Aisha: Rollout plan: canary 5% hosted traffic -> monitor cost delta and error noise for 24 hours -> expand to 25% -> full. Dedicated/private are opt-in feature flags in the console. If any spike > 20% cost or error rate > 2x baseline, immediate rollback.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: obs-service v0.8.1 -> 5% traffic.

Jon: I'll prep a dashboard template + a "copy to customer" export option so SEs can repro for enterprise asks.

Priya: Docs/notes: we'll add an instrumentation page showing X-Req-ID usage and a migration note for customers already sending req-id. Also include small sample client snippet.

Samira: One more follow-up: include a lightweight alerting UI (webhook URL + on/off + routing) but not templated threshold presets — we can ship a basic toggle and expand later.

Aisha: Owners & deadlines (rough): Jon — UI mocks & template (Wed); Priya — APIs + docs (Tue); Samira — SLOs & acceptance tests (Thu); Aisha — coordinate canary + comms (Fri). Please confirm by EOD. :party_parrot:
